explanation: The PALOMA-2 figures and 'not statistically significant' claim are well supported. However, the specific claim that PALOMA-3 fulvestrant OS 'reached significance only in a later exploratory analysis after 73 months' is not established—cited evidence describes the 73.3-month analysis timing but never states whether OS reached statistical significance at either follow-up point.
suggested_rewrite: PALOMA-3's fulvestrant combination showed a numerically longer OS at 44.8 months follow-up; an updated exploratory analysis extended follow-up to 73.3 months (75% of patients had died), though significance at either timepoint is not confirmed here.
